concerns.location: plan.md: Complexity Tracking table, FR-011 row
concerns.text: FR-011 is mapped to 'Phase 3 — permutation validation on real pipeline inputs', but the plan's Phase 3 text says validation runs on 'null synthetic data'. FR-011 explicitly requires validation 'on real data'; substituting synthetic null-data false-positive checks validates the machinery, not the pipeline-on-real-data as the spec demands. State explicitly that FR-011's real-data clause is deferred alongside FR-001 (with the same re-plan trigger) rather than claiming it is covered.

The plan honestly flags that no verified dataset exists and the scientific question remains unanswered, but the re-plan trigger is only mentioned in passing ('A re-plan is triggered when a verified dataset is identified'). Add a concrete, testable trigger condition (e.g., a named dataset passing the verified-dataset gate with both adolescent rs-fMRI and a training variable) so the deferred real-data path is actionable rather than aspirational.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-011 vs plan.md 'Complexity Tracking' FR-011 row
concerns.text: FR-011 states 'System MUST validate the full analysis pipeline on real data using permutation testing... synthetic effect injection is NOT permitted for scientific validation.' The plan maps FR-011 to 'permutation validation on real pipeline inputs' but Phase 3 actually validates on synthetic null data ('null synthetic data must yield FDR/NBS false-positive rates at nominal levels'). No real-data validation is planned because no verified dataset exists. The plan flags the FR-001 real-data gap but does not equally flag that FR-011's real-data validation clause is unmet; the spec needs an explicit conditional/deferred clause for FR-011 mirroring the FR-001 treatment, or the plan needs a re-plan trigger tied to FR-011.

The spec defines a Key Entity 'NetworkMetric' (aggregated connectivity strength per network: auditory, motor, executive, derived from ConnectivityMatrix). Neither the plan's project structure, the data-model entities (Subject, ConnectivityMatrix, StatisticalResult, NetworkComponent), nor the contracts contain any NetworkMetric entity or network-level aggregation step. Either add a plan element producing network-level metrics or remove/merge the entity in the spec.

FR-006 requires the system to 'automatically sample or subset data if necessary to comply' with the 7 GB limit. The plan's memory_monitor 'aborts >7 GB' — an abort is not the adaptive sampling/subsetting the FR mandates. Either the plan should implement the fallback (e.g., per-subject streaming already largely covers it, but state the subsetting fallback explicitly) or the spec clause should be relaxed.

FR-011 row says 'permutation validation on real pipeline inputs', but Phase 3 actually validates on null SYNTHETIC data ('null synthetic data must yield FDR/NBS false-positive rates at nominal levels'). No real data exists, so the mapping row contradicts the phase description. Reword the FR-011 row to state synthetic-null permutation validation with real-data validation deferred, matching the plan's own scope notes.

spec.md defines a 'NetworkMetric' entity (aggregated network-level connectivity strength for auditory/motor/executive), but data-model.md defines only Subject, ConnectivityMatrix, StatisticalResult, NetworkComponent, and no plan step produces or consumes a NetworkMetric artifact. Either add the entity + a producing step (e.g., network-level aggregation in stats.py) or note its deliberate omission in the plan's scope notes.

Plan and quickstart use the halt message 'Insufficient Data for Power'; spec edge case 3 mandates 'Sample Size Insufficient'. Pick one string and use it consistently (the spec itself is inconsistent between US-1 scenario 1 and edge case 3, but the plan should at least name both or align with one explicitly).

concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 3 — 'Permutation-based validation of the pipeline (FR-011)'
concerns.text: FR-011 mandates validation 'on real data'; the plan validates false-positive control on synthetic null data instead. The plan is transparent about this, but the FR-011 row in the Complexity table ('permutation validation on real pipeline inputs') overstates what is delivered — no real inputs exist. Reword to state FR-011 is unmet/deferred, not satisfied by the synthetic permutation runs.

concerns.location: plan.md: Phase 1 — 'Inclusion audit (SC-005): report fraction of subjects with valid labels + complete data; assert ≥90%'
concerns.text: On synthetic data this audit is true by construction — the generator emits complete, validly-labeled rows by design, so the ≥90% assertion can only pass and validates nothing about the pipeline. State that SC-005 is only meaningful in real-data mode, or add a deliberate corruption/missingness injection so the audit has a genuine failure mode to detect.

concerns.location: research.md §2.5 / plan.md Phase 1 — 'propensity matching ... plus edge-wise residualization regardless'
concerns.text: Applying both matching and residualization is defensible but the plan should note the matched sample is a subset of the residualized analysis set (or clarify ordering), since residualizing an already-matched sample changes the estimand slightly. One sentence suffices.
